methodology.runtime: Single esbuild local-source ESM bundle + React test renderer; excludes browser paint/layout and real network
methodology.completionMs: Wall time through settled React/HTTP state, including unchanged 75/150 ms batching delays
methodology.activeCpuMs: Process user+system CPU per stage, includes rendering and fixture request handling
methodology.renderMs: React Profiler actualDuration; overlaps activeCpuMs and synchronous callback times
methodology.dispatchMs: Synchronous EventSource dispatch after JSON encoding, includes parsing and handlers
methodology.timerCallbackMs: Synchronous window.setTimeout callbacks, including synchronous renders
methodology.heap: GC-retained delta after module compilation/import, server shutdown and fixture construction, excluding setup
